comments.author: @HectorGutz
comments.text: Who the hell needs a "nut job" like trump as President?  We are a moral people, never of the "Epstein Class."  Only those submitted to bribe, and with an inferiority complex, in Puerto Rico, glorify being a part of that warmongering nation; that only solves diplomatic situations by sanctions or bombing.  We have class, dignity, honor, nor do "we cheat, lie or steal" like ex Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, proudly bragged about, as he defined the character of the U.S.Government.
